_note: Extra trail finds (round 2 of the trail life job). Same format as trail_finds.json; loaded by the alive2 block of index.html. New kinds: antler, boot, ski, feeder, thermos.

finds.text: A shed antler, bleached smooth. Whoever wore it is still around, and now slightly lighter.
One boot, standing upright in the snow. Laces tied. Nobody in it. You decide not to look inside.
A single ski, planted in the snow like a flag. Initials carved in the tail: 'N.H. was here, then went.'
A bird feeder on a post, full of seed. Tiny footprints everywhere, and one very large ones. Both fed.
A red thermos, left on a stump. It is still hot. The cocoa tastes of cinnamon and slight guilt.
Another antler. Somebody is losing their crown, one tree at a time.
A lone boot, still warm. There is a second one somewhere. You do not go looking.
A ski with a note taped on: 'Back in five minutes.' The tape is very old.
A bird feeder. The robin on it gives you a look: 'You're late.'
Someone left a thermos for the next walker. You are the next walker.
An antler stuck upright in the snow like a tiny leafless tree.
